process.title: Process
process.heading: From the first message to your site online.
process.intro: Five steps. In each one you know what I do and what I need from you.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: You tell me what you need and who it is for. We sort it out over WhatsApp, with messages or voice notes to move faster, and if you would rather talk we book a call. We come out of it with the package chosen.

steps.title: You book
steps.description: The deposit holds your slot in the schedule and starts the work. I send you a short checklist of what I need: logo, texts, photos and socials. If something is missing, we sort it out together.

steps.title: Design and development
steps.description: I build your site from scratch and share progress as I go. The delivery time starts running once I have all the material.

steps.title: Revisions
steps.description: Two rounds of changes to leave it the way you had it in your head. In each round you gather your comments and send them in one go.

steps.title: Delivery and launch
steps.description: You see the finished site in a preview. You approve it, you pay the balance and I publish it on your domain, ready to go.

notes.label: Hosting
notes.body: Included. Nothing extra to pay to keep the site online.

notes.label: Domain
notes.body: You buy it yourself, around USD 10 to 15 a year, and it stays in your name. Setting it up is on me.

notes.label: Maintenance
notes.body: No monthly fee. Once the site is live it keeps running on its own; later changes are quoted when you want them, never charged as a retainer.
